sources.quote: effective today Meccanica C S.p.A. is on probation (supplier rating C minus)

findings.why: Meccanica C has been on probation since 2026-08-14, and no later document lifts it. It cannot receive new parts now, so BR-220 cannot be moved to it.

sources.quote: Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: The approved source list covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL. Only Alluminio B is approved, and Meccanica C has no approval for BR-220. Its BR-180 approval does not carry over to another part.

sources.quote: BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6
billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-09-02 (PPAP-2024-077)
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C is in force and calls for EN AW-6082-T6. Rev B is superseded. Meccanica C's only approved billet grade is 6061-T6. The email that calls 6061-T6 acceptable for BR-220 is informal and relies on outdated material data, so it does not override Rev C.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: None of the documents holds a certificate or test result for a Meccanica C billet in EN AW-6082-T6 against Rev C. A person must supply it.
